messages:
Maria Chen: Morning — quick async standup for docs/SDKs/quickstarts.

Jake O'Neil: Did: updated Node SDK quickstart with OAuth example. PR #482 open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Needs a quick review.

Priya Patel: Did: fixed typo in embeddings.md and patched sample code. Blocker: failing e2e on sample-app due to env var parsing in Dockerfile (containers crash on start).

Liam Brooks: Did: landed Python SDK retry logic. Today: add tests for streaming responses. Blocker: flaky test `test_stream_chunking`.

Alina Gómez: Did: wrote new quickstart for Remix + Redwood hosted API; added example app under /examples/remix-quickstart. Need a copy edit and a short screenshot.

Samir Rao: Did: ran smoke tests on sample-app, saw intermittent 502s when redis cache is cold. Investigating logs and TTLs.

docs-bot: Reminder — new ops guide template available at https://intranet.redwood/docs/ops-template :memo:

Maria Chen: Quick asks — @Jake @Liam could you review #482 and #479 by EOD? Also @Priya can you paste the failing Dockerfile snippet here so Samir can try a patch?

Jake O'Neil: On it, will do reviews after standup :eyes: 

Liam Brooks: I can pick up #479 after lunch, assigning to self.

Priya Patel: Dockerfile snippet:
```
ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}"
COPY . /app
```
might be stripping quotes; trying `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` + switching to `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY` to avoid literal quotes being inserted.

Samir Rao: Thanks — I'll try the ARG change and run the container locally, will report back in this thread.

Alina Gómez: Small doc fix: rename `quickstart.md` -> `QUICKSTART.md` for visibility in repo root, will open PR.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. If no blockers, we'll cut the docs release branch tomorrow morning. :rocket:

Jake O'Neil: FYI — leaving a note in #eng-releases with the planned branch and timing.

Liam Brooks: Ping me if streaming tests keep failing, I can run the test matrix on my workstation.

Priya Patel: EOD plan: open PR for Dockerfile fix, add a CI job to catch env parsing issues, follow up on sample-app e2e.

Maria Chen: Great — that's all for now. If you're blocked ping me or drop a thread here. :thumbsup:
